mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_users u WHERE #{purpose} = 'PROFILE' AND u.profile_image_id = #{fileId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM tb_courses c WHERE #{purpose} = 'COURSE_THUMBNAIL' AND c.thumbnail_file_id = #{fileId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED') UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM tb_courses c JOIN tb_course_attachments a ON a.course_id = c.id WHERE #{purpose} = 'COURSE_ATTACHMENT' AND a.file_id = #{fileId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED') UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM tb_institutions i WHERE #{purpose} = 'INSTITUTION_LOGO' AND i.logo_file_id = #{fileId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM tb_notices n JOIN tb_notice_attachments a ON a.notice_id = n.id WHERE #{purpose} = 'NOTICE_ATTACHMENT' AND a.file_id = #{fileId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND n.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND n.published_at <= #{now} UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM tb_banners b WHERE #{purpose} = 'BANNER' AND (b.pc_image_file_id = #{fileId} OR b.mobile_image_file_id = #{fileId}) AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND (b.visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR (b.visibility = 'SCHEDULED' AND b.start_at <= #{now} AND b.end_at >= #{now})) UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM tb_badge_definitions d WHERE #{purpose} = 'BADGE_IMAGE' AND (d.image_file_id = #{fileId} OR d.rule_params -> 'levels' @> ) AND d.active = TRUE )
